title: Working Out the Amount a Client Tenders on a Micro Market Settlement Invoice
content:
What a client of the Unattended Micro Market Program tenders is the balance standing on the agreement over the charge-reading window rather than the face of one invoice alone, and the payment is recorded against the settlement invoice the client is settling.

## The balance standing

The balance standing is the settlement charges read over that window, plus the shrink adjustments posted over the two months to the day the payment is taken, less the credits set against the settlement and less the settlement payments already recorded over those same two months, and it is never taken below nothing.

## The two reductions

From that balance the withheld amount is taken off, again never below nothing; the prompt-settlement discount is then taken off what is left; and the group-settlement offset is taken off the figure that step produces, so that the two reductions act one after the other on a shrinking figure rather than being added together and taken once.

The credits set against the settlement, the balance standing, the figure left when the withheld amount is taken off, the figure the prompt-settlement discount leaves and the amount tendered are each rounded to the nearest cent as they are taken, a figure falling exactly on the half-cent going to the nearest even cent.

## The figures the calculation reads

The charge-reading window is the month to the day the payment is taken. Nothing is withheld from the balance. The credits standing on the agreement are set against the settlement in full, at the full credit share of 100 per cent. No prompt-settlement discount is given. No group-settlement offset is given.

## A tender worked through

*Hypothetical inputs.* The settlement charges posted over the month to the day the payment is taken total 4746.00 USD. Shrink adjustments posted over the two months to that day total 310.00 USD. Credits standing on the agreement over those two months total 180.00 USD, and settlement payments already recorded over those two months total nothing.

The credits set against the settlement are 180.00 USD, being the whole of them. The balance standing is 4876.00 USD, being 4746.00 USD and 310.00 USD together, less 180.00 USD and less nothing. Nothing is withheld, so the figure stays at 4876.00 USD. No prompt-settlement discount is taken, and no group-settlement offset, so the amount tendered is 4876.00 USD.

*Hypothetical inputs, second case.* Were the credits and payments over those two months to exceed the charges and shrink together, the balance standing would be nothing rather than a negative figure, and nothing would be tendered.
